website_url.title: Website Url
website_url.description: Site to extract from. Omit to re-extract the org's current website.

BrandExtractionRequest.title: BrandExtractionRequest
BrandExtractionRequest.description:
Mirrors `campaign_builder.routers.brand_kit.TriggerExtractionPayload`.

`website_url` omitted re-runs extraction against the website already on the
org's company profile. Supplying one EXTRACTS A DIFFERENT SITE, which
replaces the org's design tokens and homepage capture.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: Scopes to embed in the token

BrowserExchangeRequest.title: BrowserExchangeRequest
BrowserExchangeRequest.description:
Body for the browser exchange — target app + non-identity params ONLY.

Identity is DERIVED SERVER-SIDE from the authenticated PropelAuth principal
(locked decision §5: "browser auth = PropelAuth login -> short-lived graph8
app token"): ``subject`` / ``client_org_id`` / ``role`` come from the
validated principal, never from this body, so a client cannot self-assert who
it is or escalate its role. Any ``subject`` / ``client_org_id`` / ``role``
keys a caller forges into the body are ignored (pydantic drops unknown fields).

BugReportPayload.title: BugReportPayload
BugReportPayload.description: A bug report with its status, comments and screenshots.

include_future_joiners.title: Include Future Joiners
include_future_joiners.description: When true, members who join the organisation LATER also get a copy automatically. A standing rule, not a one-off action.

BulkAssignMembersRequest.title: BulkAssignMembersRequest
BulkAssignMembersRequest.description: Give every active member a copy of a managed template.

list_id.title: List Id
list_id.description: The graph8 audience to read profiles from.

listener_type.title: Listener Type
listener_type.description: Only `user` listeners can be bulk-created from a list.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Create one listener per platform. Overrides `platform`.

BulkCreateFromListRequest.title: BulkCreateFromListRequest
BulkCreateFromListRequest.description:
Create one `user` listener per social profile on a graph8 list.

No platform lookup happens here - handles are resolved lazily by the
polling worker, so this does not consume quota per row at creation time.

BulkDealChange.title: BulkDealChange
BulkDealChange.description:
The change applied to EVERY deal in the batch.

PUT semantics, and the distinction matters: `null` leaves a value alone,
an EMPTY STRING clears it. So omitting a field and sending `""` are
different instructions, and the second one is destructive.

BulkDealUpdateRequest.title: BulkDealUpdateRequest
BulkDealUpdateRequest.description:
Apply one change to up to 100 deals.

Each deal is checked against the caller's deal scope individually; one the
caller cannot write is reported rather than aborting the batch.

BulkExtractRequest.title: BulkExtractRequest
BulkExtractRequest.description: Up to 50 extractions in one call.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA name (e.g. `America/New_York`). Voice rejects anything pytz cannot load.

BusinessHoursScheduleRequest.title: BusinessHoursScheduleRequest
BusinessHoursScheduleRequest.description:
Create or REPLACE the business-hours / after-hours pair for a number.

This is a two-rule bulk setup, not an addition: calling it again replaces
both rules rather than adding more.

BusinessHoursTargetRef.title: BusinessHoursTargetRef
BusinessHoursTargetRef.description: Where a call goes in one half of the schedule.

value.title: Value
value.description: URL for `link`, question text for `question`, slug for `calendar`.

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: URL paths where the button appears.

surface.title: Surface
surface.description: NULL shows it on BOTH widgets.

ButtonCreateRequest.title: ButtonCreateRequest
ButtonCreateRequest.description:
A quick-action button in the widget.

`value` means something different per `action`: a URL for `link`, the
question text for `question`, a calendar slug for `calendar`. Sending the
wrong kind is accepted here and fails at the widget, so it is spelled out
rather than left to be discovered.

ButtonUpdateRequest.title: ButtonUpdateRequest
ButtonUpdateRequest.description: Partial edit of a button. `chat_bot_id` locates the row.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: Structured interview answers about how this organisation sells. Injected as highest-priority grounding the next time the buying journey document is generated.

BuyingJourneyInterviewRequest.title: BuyingJourneyInterviewRequest
BuyingJourneyInterviewRequest.description:
The typed form of the untyped `dict` body the interview route takes.

The app reads `answers` and 400s when it is empty. Typed so that is a 422,
and so the shape is discoverable.

CRMImportRequest.title: CRMImportRequest
CRMImportRequest.description: Pull records out of a connected CRM into a workbench table.

start_at.title: Start At
start_at.description: Start time WITH a timezone offset.

tz.title: Tz
tz.description: IANA timezone the event is shown in, e.g. `Europe/London`.

CalendarInvitePayload.title: CalendarInvitePayload
CalendarInvitePayload.description: A calendar invite, including the public `ics_url`.

start_at.title: Start At
start_at.description: Start time WITH a timezone offset.

CallControlRequest.title: CallControlRequest
CallControlRequest.description: Mirrors `DialerCallControl`. Ends a call already in progress.

CallDispositionRequest.title: CallDispositionRequest
CallDispositionRequest.description:
Mirrors `CallDispositionRequest`. Records the outcome of a finished call.

`disposition` is left an open string on purpose: the vocabulary is
system values PLUS the org's own custom dispositions, so closing it here
would refuse a value the customer defined. `GET /voice/dispositions`
lists what this org accepts.

CallGradingResponse.title: CallGradingResponse
CallGradingResponse.description:
AI grading for a single dialer call.

The ``status`` field flips to ``"pending"`` when the upstream service
returns 204 (grading still being computed). In that case ``grading``
will be empty and ``reviewed`` will be ``False``. Callers can poll
until ``status == "ready"``.

CallResultSearchRequest.title: CallResultSearchRequest
CallResultSearchRequest.description: Filter recorded call outcomes. A POST because the filter is a body.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The agent whose persona and knowledge shape the script.

contact_id.title: Contact Id
contact_id.description: The contact the call is for; drives memory retrieval.

prospect_info.title: Prospect Info
prospect_info.description: What you know about the prospect.

company_context.title: Company Context
company_context.description: What you know about the prospect's company.

call_type.title: Call Type
call_type.description: professional, casual, cold_call, follow_up, demo or closing.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: LLM provider.

model.title: Model
model.description: openai: gpt-4o or gpt-4o-mini. anthropic: claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 or claude-opus-4-6. Voice rejects any other pairing with a 422.

CallSummaryRow.title: CallSummaryRow
CallSummaryRow.description:
Light-weight dialer call summary returned in the dialer-call list.

Deliberately omits the transcript blob - transcripts are 5-50 KB each
and including them in a list would blow caller context budget. Use
``has_transcript`` to decide whether a follow-up GET to
``/voice/dialer/calls/{room_name}/transcript`` is worthwhile.

``contact_id``, ``from_``, and ``to`` are included so client-side
polling consumers (SDR ingestion pipelines) can filter without an
extra round-trip for each row.

CallTranscriptResponse.title: CallTranscriptResponse
CallTranscriptResponse.description:
Full transcript payload for a single dialer call.

Mirrors the grading response shape: ``status="ready"`` when the
transcript has been flushed to the database, ``status="empty"`` when
the call row exists but the persistor has not yet written the
transcript column (the call may still be in progress or the flush
may be in-flight). 404 is raised by the route on a missing row.

CallTranscriptSegment.title: CallTranscriptSegment
CallTranscriptSegment.description:
One speaker turn in a persisted dialer transcript.

``speaker`` is one of ``SDR | AI | HUMAN | BOT`` (voice service does
not gate the value, so consumers should treat unknown values as
pass-through rather than rejecting the row). ``timestamp`` is the
voice-service-emitted ISO-8601 string and may be missing on very
early rows that pre-date timestamping in dialer_events.py.

CallsListResponse.title: CallsListResponse
CallsListResponse.description:
List wrapper for dialer call history.

Used by ``GET /voice/dialer/calls`` for ALL filter variants
(contact_id, user_email, parallel_session_id, created_after). Echoes
the applied filter values back so callers can sanity-check what the
server actually applied (the proxy may pin org_id, normalize CRM
overlay IDs, etc).

list_id.title: List Id
list_id.description: List ID to attach as the campaign's audience. Pass null to detach. The list must already exist in this org (matches audiences.id, the canonical lists table — accepts an integer or its string form).

CampaignAttachAudienceRequest.title: CampaignAttachAudienceRequest
CampaignAttachAudienceRequest.description: Body for PUT /campaigns/{id}/audience — attach (or detach with null) a list.

file_type.title: File Type
file_type.description: Document type, for example campaign_brief or sequence

structured_data.title: Structured Data
structured_data.description: Optional structured payload (e.g., sequence steps, persona JSON) stored alongside the markdown content at meta_data.structured_data. Mirrors the update path so the MCP create+update flow is symmetric.

CampaignDocumentManifestRequest.title: CampaignDocumentManifestRequest
CampaignDocumentManifestRequest.description: Preview which documents a campaign would generate. Spends nothing.

id.title: Id
id.description: Existing document id. When omitted, a new document is created.

file_type.title: File Type
file_type.description: Required when creating; ignored on update of existing id.

structured_data.title: Structured Data
structured_data.description: Optional structured data, merged into meta_data.structured_data.

audience_list_id.title: Audience List Id
audience_list_id.description: If provided (including empty string treated as detach), updates audience_list_id. Use the dedicated PUT /audience endpoint when you only need to attach.

detach_audience.title: Detach Audience
detach_audience.description: Set true to explicitly DETACH the audience (audience_list_id=NULL). Required because JSON null in audience_list_id is ambiguous (could mean 'no change').

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Per-document patches. Existing docs are updated in place (id required); new docs are created when id is omitted and file_type+display_name are present.

sequence_steps.title: Sequence Steps
sequence_steps.description: If provided, replaces the sequence step ordering (same as PUT /sequence).

linked_sequence_ids.title: Linked Sequence Ids
linked_sequence_ids.description: Existing sequence IDs to bind to this campaign. INSERTs rows with status='linked' into cb_campaign_sequence_links. Skips IDs that are already linked (any status). Use for pre-launch wiring of an existing sequence; launch writes its own 'pushed' audit rows.

unlink_sequence_ids.title: Unlink Sequence Ids
unlink_sequence_ids.description: Sequence IDs to UNLINK from this campaign. DELETEs ONLY rows where status='linked'. Launch-audit rows (status='pushed'/'superseded'/'failed') are never touched — those are an immutable historical record.

CampaignFullPatchRequest.title: CampaignFullPatchRequest
CampaignFullPatchRequest.description:
Deep-update payload for `PATCH /campaigns/{id}/full`.

Every field is optional. Each non-null section is applied in the same
transaction — campaign fields → audience → documents → sequence — so a
single call can re-shape the whole campaign without ping-pong.

auto_generate_landing_page.title: Auto Generate Landing Page
auto_generate_landing_page.description: Generate a landing page alongside a new campaign.

auto_generate_ad_images.title: Auto Generate Ad Images
auto_generate_ad_images.description: Generate ad images alongside a new campaign.

CampaignGenerationUpdateRequest.title: CampaignGenerationUpdateRequest
CampaignGenerationUpdateRequest.description:
Mirrors `UpdateCampaignGenerationSettingsRequest`.

Both default to TRUE, so an empty body turns both toggles ON. That is the
app's shape and it is a real trap: a partial body is not a partial update.

sender_mailbox_ids.title: Sender Mailbox Ids
sender_mailbox_ids.description: Explicit list of mailbox IDs (from GET /mailboxes) to attach as sequence channels before launch. Each ID must reference a connection_status='active', non-archived mailbox in this org. When omitted, the bridge auto-picks the first active email mailbox (ORDER BY id ASC). If no supported sender is available, launch fails before sequence creation.

disable_auto_pick.title: Disable Auto Pick
disable_auto_pick.description: Deprecated safety escape hatch. Launch now rejects True because a consequential action cannot proceed without an active sender.

textual_agent_name.title: Textual Agent Name
textual_agent_name.description: Voice-service agent identifier (from GET /agents) used for email / social steps. Stamped onto seqsequences.textual_agent_name. Pass the same value as `voice_agent_name` to use one agent across all channels (the common case — the unified Agent row already bundles persona + voice + phone + the attached appointment event).

voice_agent_name.title: Voice Agent Name
voice_agent_name.description: Voice-service agent identifier (from GET /agents) used for phone / SMS steps. Stamped onto seqsequences.voice_agent_name. When you want a single agent for all channels, set both this and `textual_agent_name` to the same value.

schedule_id.title: Schedule Id
schedule_id.description: Send-window schedule UUID (from GET /schedules). Stamped onto seqsequences.schedule_id. When omitted the sequencer falls back to its org-default send window.

appointment_id.title: Appointment Id
appointment_id.description: Calendar event-type ID (from GET /event-types) to attach as the booking link on the sequence. Stamped onto seqsequences.appointment_id. When omitted no booking link is attached and any sequence step referencing `{{booking_link}}` will render the org-default link (or empty).

CampaignLaunchRequest.title: CampaignLaunchRequest
CampaignLaunchRequest.description:
Optional body for ``POST /campaigns/{id}/launch`` — all fields optional.

Callers that POST with no body (or an empty {}) use the first active email
mailbox for the organization. Callers that want explicit control pass
``sender_mailbox_ids``. Launch fails before sequence creation when no
supported active sender is available.

The MCP `g8_gtm_launch_campaign` wrapper passes ``sender_mailbox_ids`` when
Daniel's agent already picked a sender; otherwise the auto-pick fallback
keeps the one-shot launch flow working with no extra round-trip.

CampaignSetPersona.title: CampaignSetPersona
CampaignSetPersona.description: A buyer persona, as the lens pass needs to see it.

step_id.title: Step Id
step_id.description: Sequencer step the click was attributed to

visits.title: Visits
visits.description: Click events by this contact in the window

last_path.title: Last Path
last_path.description: Most recent path this contact clicked to

CampaignVisitorContact.title: CampaignVisitorContact
CampaignVisitorContact.description:
One row of the Top contacts table.

Carries PII (``name`` / ``email``) for the org's own contacts. Omitted
entirely from the response when the request passes ``include_contacts=false``.

events.title: Events
events.description: Human click events on this URL (scanner-filtered)

unique_contacts.title: Unique Contacts
unique_contacts.description: Distinct contacts who clicked this URL

step_ids.title: Step Ids
step_ids.description: Sequencer steps whose links drove these clicks

emails_with_link.title: Emails With Link
emails_with_link.description: Sends whose template embedded this URL (CTR denominator)

ctr_percent.title: Ctr Percent
ctr_percent.description: events ÷ emails_with_link × 100, clamped [0,100]; null when no denominator

step_labels.title: Step Labels
step_labels.description: Human-readable labels for step_ids when resolvable

CampaignVisitorLink.title: CampaignVisitorLink
CampaignVisitorLink.description: One row of the Email Link Engagement table (a clicked destination URL).

events.title: Events
events.description: Campaign click events attributed to this step

unique_contacts.title: Unique Contacts
unique_contacts.description: Distinct contacts who clicked from this step

emails_sent.title: Emails Sent
emails_sent.description: EMAIL sends dispatched from this step in the window

emails_with_link.title: Emails With Link
emails_with_link.description: Of those sends, how many carried a link

CampaignVisitorStep.title: CampaignVisitorStep
CampaignVisitorStep.description: One row of the Top campaign steps table.

CampaignVisitorsReport.title: CampaignVisitorsReport
CampaignVisitorsReport.description: Composite Campaign Visitors report for a single org (analytics report a23).

total_page_events.title: Total Page Events
total_page_events.description: All page events in the window (campaign + non-campaign)

unique_contacts.title: Unique Contacts
unique_contacts.description: Distinct contacts who clicked a campaign link

unique_campaign_steps.title: Unique Campaign Steps
unique_campaign_steps.description: Distinct sequencer steps that drew clicks

identified_visitors.title: Identified Visitors
identified_visitors.description: Distinct identified web sessions on campaign clicks

jitsu_wired.title: Jitsu Wired
jitsu_wired.description: False when the org has no visitor-tracking pipeline / no page events

unparseable_pageviews.title: Unparseable Pageviews
unparseable_pageviews.description: Campaign clicks whose tracking hash could not be decoded

encrypted_pageviews.title: Encrypted Pageviews
encrypted_pageviews.description: Diagnostic: campaign clicks with an encrypted (#c=e1.) hash

plaintext_pageviews.title: Plaintext Pageviews
plaintext_pageviews.description: Diagnostic: campaign clicks with a plaintext hash

contact_rows.title: Contact Rows
contact_rows.description: Total (contact, step) click groups before the `limit` cap

step_rows.title: Step Rows
step_rows.description: Total distinct campaign steps before the `limit` cap

link_rows.title: Link Rows
link_rows.description: Total distinct clicked (host, path) before the ceiling

CampaignVisitorsSummary.title: CampaignVisitorsSummary
CampaignVisitorsSummary.description:
KPI tiles for the org's campaign-click activity in the window.

All click-derived counters are email-security-scanner filtered (humans only)
when ``SEQUENCER_VISITOR_SCANNER_FILTER=enforce`` — the same honest counts the
in-app report shows. ``total_page_events`` is all page volume (not filtered).

days.title: Days
days.description: Inclusive calendar-day span of the window

CampaignVisitorsWindow.title: CampaignVisitorsWindow
CampaignVisitorsWindow.description: The resolved reporting window echoed back to the caller.

CampaignWorkflowPayload.title: CampaignWorkflowPayload
CampaignWorkflowPayload.description: A campaign-workflow link, generation progress or save result.

channel_id.title: Channel Id
channel_id.description: Channel resource ID (mailbox ID, phone ID, etc.)

channel_value.title: Channel Value
channel_value.description: Channel value (email address, phone number, etc.)

channel_type.title: Channel Type
channel_type.description: Channel type. One of: SMTP, GMAIL, INBOXKIT, PHONE, LINKEDIN, SMS, WHATSAPP. Case-insensitive.

value.title: Value
value.description: New value. The service rejects a value the key does not accept with a 422.

fetch_engagements.title: Fetch Engagements
fetch_engagements.description: Fetch who engaged with each matched post. Multiplies what a poll costs.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: Optional voice/text agent id used to seed the new bot's external chat agent. When omitted, no agent row is created.

agent_name.title: Agent Name
agent_name.description: Display name of the selected agent. Stored on the agent row so the widget shows the AGENT's name, not the bot's. Falls back to the bot name when omitted.

ChatBotCreateRequest.title: ChatBotCreateRequest
ChatBotCreateRequest.description:
A new chat bot.

An org can run several. `chat_bot_id` is REQUIRED on almost every other
call on this surface because the same org's agents, buttons, questions,
blogs and theme are all per-bot - so create one of these first, or read the
org's existing bots from `GET /webchat/chat-bots`.

expected_revision.title: Expected Revision
expected_revision.description: Revision you last read. Omit to overwrite unconditionally.

ChatBotUpdateRequest.title: ChatBotUpdateRequest
ChatBotUpdateRequest.description:
Rename a chat bot.

`name` is REQUIRED even though this is a PATCH - it is the only mutable
field, and the app's model requires it. `expected_revision` is the
optimistic-concurrency check: send the revision you read, and a concurrent
edit comes back 409 rather than silently overwriting.

sort_by.title: Sort By
sort_by.description: Field to sort by. See `SortByField` for the accepted values.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Keep chats carrying ANY of these tag ids.

exclude_tag_ids.title: Exclude Tag Ids
exclude_tag_ids.description: Drop chats carrying ANY of these tag ids. This is what makes a Focused view work - the app sends the archived/deleted/warmup/bounced tags here. Without it those threads come back.

ChatSearchRequest.title: ChatSearchRequest
ChatSearchRequest.description: Filter and page the chat inbox.

ChatStarRequest.title: ChatStarRequest
ChatStarRequest.description:
Set, rather than toggle, the starred state.

Declared as a required bool for exactly that reason: a toggle is not
idempotent, so a retried request would silently un-star the thread it just
starred.

hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: The hostname to serve this app on. Normalized server-side: case, a trailing dot and unicode all resolve to one canonical form.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Which mashup PK to filter by.

values.title: Values
values.description: Up to 100 key values (UP_IDs, HEMs, or domains).

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Which mashup table to read. 'joined' returns the lighter denormalized mashup_new with both profiles partially populated.

since.title: Since
since.description: ISO date or datetime (inclusive lower bound).

until.title: Until
until.description: ISO date or datetime (exclusive upper bound). Defaults to now.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Optional equality filters. Keys must match dataset columns; unknown columns are silently dropped so an LLM guess can't produce a SQL error.

aggregation.title: Aggregation
aggregation.description: 'raw' returns the matching rows (capped). 'daily_counts' returns {day, count}. 'top_n' returns {value, count} grouped by the dataset's primary group key (contact_id, company_id, keyword_id).

CloneHomepageRequest.title: CloneHomepageRequest
CloneHomepageRequest.description: Clone the org's own homepage into an editable page. SPENDS CREDIT.

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Original filename - drives format detection (e.g. dialer.astro).

CloneHtmlRequest.title: CloneHtmlRequest
CloneHtmlRequest.description:
Clone from raw source the caller already has. SPENDS CREDIT.

`use_vision` defaults OFF here, unlike `/clone-url`: there is no live page
to screenshot, so the extra pass buys much less.

use_vision.title: Use Vision
use_vision.description: Multimodal pass. Costs more. Default on.

CloneUrlRequest.title: CloneUrlRequest
CloneUrlRequest.description:
Clone any public URL into an editable page. SPENDS CREDIT.

It fetches the page and runs an extraction pass; `use_vision` adds a
multimodal pass on a screenshot, which costs more and is the default
because it is what makes the clone usable.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Which list this reason belongs to, e.g. won or lost.

CloseReasonCreateRequest.title: CloseReasonCreateRequest
CloseReasonCreateRequest.description:
Add a close reason.

Adding one is gated on `_REASON_MUTATE_PERMISSIONS` (the app's own route
gate): deliberately wider than the manager tier - a rep extends the list
inline while closing their own deal - but NOT open to org members with no
deal access. REMOVING one carries the same entry gate plus a creator-or-
manager check, because manager-only removal would make every rep's typo
permanent and org-wide.

can_manage.title: Can Manage
can_manage.description: Whether this caller may archive reasons they did not create.

CloseReasonListResponse.title: CloseReasonListResponse
CloseReasonListResponse.description:
The close reasons, plus what this caller may do with them.

`can_manage` is returned alongside the list ON PURPOSE: it is resolved by
the same rule the archive endpoint enforces, so a UI cannot render a delete
control the backend would refuse - or hide one it would allow.

CoachListPayload.title: CoachListPayload
CoachListPayload.description: An open envelope for a LIST result, so a bare list keeps its shape.

CoachPayload.title: CoachPayload
CoachPayload.description: An open envelope for a call, an interview round or an attempt.

CollectionCreateRequest.title: CollectionCreateRequest
CollectionCreateRequest.description: A new knowledge collection. Bounds mirror voice's own `Query` limits.

CollectionFolder.title: CollectionFolder
CollectionFolder.description:
The folder to create. Voice binds `folder_path` as a query parameter;
it is a body field here so a path with slashes needs no URL escaping.

folder_path.title: Folder Path
folder_path.description: Folder inside the collection. Empty is the root.

CollectionPasteText.title: CollectionPasteText
CollectionPasteText.description:
`POST .../files/paste-text` binds its body as FORM fields (`org_id`,
`folder_path`, `filename`, `text_content`); this is the JSON shape the API
takes, with `org_id` injected from the key.

CollectionUpdateRequest.title: CollectionUpdateRequest
CollectionUpdateRequest.description: Rename or re-describe a collection. Omit a field to leave it alone.

ColorSwap.title: ColorSwap
ColorSwap.description: One colour replaced by another, both as hex.

is_global.title: Is Global
is_global.description: Automatically computed: True if object_id is None/empty, False otherwise.

Column.title: Column
Column.description:
Column entity representing a database column definition.
Used to describe table column metadata for MashupContact and other entities.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'all' copies every column; 'selected' uses the list below.

ColumnConfigDto.title: ColumnConfigDto
ColumnConfigDto.description: Which columns travel with a routed record.

ColumnMappingDto.title: ColumnMappingDto
ColumnMappingDto.description: Map a search result field onto a destination column.

ColumnSource.title: ColumnSource
ColumnSource.description:
Which entity a field in the contact field list belongs to.

The ``GET /contacts/columns`` response deliberately combines fields from
three provenances into one list (issue #21184): the person record, their
employer's company record, and user-created custom columns. Consumers
(form-mapping UI, AI-agent field listing, CSV import) need to tell them
apart — a company field like ``COMPANY_REVENUE`` describes the employer,
not the contact.

- ``contact``: a field on the person record (``MashupContact.*``) — the default.
- ``company``: a field on the contact's employer (``MashupCompany.*``),
  surfaced so contacts can be mapped/filtered by company attributes.
- ``custom``: a user-created dynamic column (global or list-scoped).

ColumnType.title: ColumnType
ColumnType.description:
User-selectable dynamic-column data types.

Every member must have a physical type in the repos' pg_type_map
(contacts/companies CDP repos + enrichment DynamicColumnRepository:
int→INTEGER, numeric→NUMERIC, text→TEXT, boolean→BOOLEAN) and belong to
the user-owned family in lists/usecases/dynamic_column_write_contract.py —
both already list these four. Write paths coerce values per type via
shared.infrustructure.db.cdp.dynamic_column_values.coerce_dynamic_value.

CommentAttachmentRef.title: CommentAttachmentRef
CommentAttachmentRef.description:
A file already uploaded to the private note namespace.

Only `token` and `key` are load-bearing: the server re-validates the
capability token and never trusts the name, size or type a client sends.
They are accepted because the app's model accepts them.

mentioned_user_ids.title: Mentioned User Ids
mentioned_user_ids.description: Mentioned users by id. Each gets a Work task.

mentioned_user_emails.title: Mentioned User Emails
mentioned_user_emails.description: The same users by email. Additive - this is what drives the notification.

CommentCreateRequest.title: CommentCreateRequest
CommentCreateRequest.description:
An INTERNAL note on a conversation. The customer never sees it.

Mentioning someone creates them a task in the Work app. The two mention
lists are ADDITIVE rather than alternatives: an id with no matching email
still gets the task, it just gets no notification - so sending both is how
you get the bell as well.

CommissionConfig.title: CommissionConfig
CommissionConfig.description:
Commission model. v1 supports ``none`` and ``per_meeting`` only —
``revenue_pct`` needs per-rep deal attribution we don't have cleanly yet
(Phase 2), so it is rejected by the validator.

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: Make this the org's default committee (unsets the previous one).

remove.title: Remove
remove.description: Contact ids to take off the committee.

CommitteeEditRequest.title: CommitteeEditRequest
CommitteeEditRequest.description:
Add and remove buying-committee members in one call.

A committee edit rides plan versioning like everything else: it persists a
NEW plan version, preserving the existing steps. Both lists are applied in
the same version, so adding and removing in one request cannot leave the
committee half-changed.

note.title: Note
note.description: Optional invite note. Capped by LinkedIn at 300 characters.

CommitteeLinkedInInviteRequest.title: CommitteeLinkedInInviteRequest
CommitteeLinkedInInviteRequest.description:
The optional note on a LinkedIn connection request.

300 characters is LinkedIn's own cap, not a display limit.

abm_category.title: Abm Category
abm_category.description: The role slot. Null keeps the persona on the committee with no role.

role.title: Role
role.description: Their part in the decision, e.g. "champion".

CommitteeMemberInput.title: CommitteeMemberInput
CommitteeMemberInput.description: A contact to put on the buying committee.

members.title: Members
members.description: The FULL roster. Personas left out are removed from the committee.

include_subsidiaries.title: Include Subsidiaries
include_subsidiaries.description: Roll subsidiary postings into the parent. Off by default: one row = one company. NOTE: when true, `jobs` expands to child companies but `open_jobs` stays parent-only, so len(jobs) can exceed open_jobs.

CompaniesOpenJobsRequest.title: CompaniesOpenJobsRequest
CompaniesOpenJobsRequest.description:
Request contract for the hiring-signal batch lookup.

Field-for-field identical to the main-app model of the same name in
``companies/interfaces/fastapi/router.py``. It is redefined here rather
than imported because that module imports
``developer_api.dependencies.hybrid_auth``; importing it back would couple
the two app halves at import time. ``test_companies_open_jobs_api.py`` locks
the two models together so the duplication cannot silently drift.

list_id.title: List Id
list_id.description: Target list ID

custom_fields.title: Custom Fields
custom_fields.description: Custom column values to write on this record, keyed by the column's display title (e.g. 'Followup 1'), its slug (e.g. 'udo_followup_1_ab12cd34'), or a case/space variant of the title. Keys that match no existing column are reported back in `ignored_fields` unless `create_missing_fields` is true.

create_missing_fields.title: Create Missing Fields
create_missing_fields.description: When true, any key in `custom_fields` that matches no existing column is created as a NEW list-scoped custom column (max 100 per request) and then written. Default false preserves the previous behaviour of not creating columns implicitly.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email address. Also the company-grouping key.

company_name.title: Company Name
company_name.description: Company name, used only when the domain is unknown.

role.title: Role
role.description: Buying-committee role: decision_maker | influencer | champion | end_user | blocker | coach.

CompanyContactImport.title: CompanyContactImport
CompanyContactImport.description:
One contact in a company import.

Contacts are grouped by email domain, so `email` decides which company a
row lands on - `company_name` only names a company that does not exist yet.

list_id.title: List Id
list_id.description: Optional list to add the company to after creation

CompanyCreateRequest.title: CompanyCreateRequest
CompanyCreateRequest.description:
Request body for creating a company.

``domain`` is required — it drives dedup (an existing company with the same
domain is reused, not duplicated) and the Deals company picker. Every other
field is optional.

linkedin_company_ids.title: Linkedin Company Ids
linkedin_company_ids.description: LinkedIn company ids (lcids). Capped at 1000 - one grid page, not a corpus scan.

CompanyJobCountsRequest.title: CompanyJobCountsRequest
CompanyJobCountsRequest.description: Active-job counts for a page of companies.

CompanyListItem.title: CompanyListItem
CompanyListItem.description: Lighter company representation for list endpoints.

website_url.title: Website Url
website_url.description: The client's real website. This is the source of truth Studio generation reads; setting it wrong is what makes every downstream ICP, persona and campaign describe the wrong company.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Profile fields to save, e.g. {'company_name': 'Acme', 'industry': 'Manufacturing'}. Replaces the stored field set.

unapprove_if_approved.title: Unapprove If Approved
unapprove_if_approved.description: Approved profiles are immutable by design. Set true to explicitly unlock and overwrite a human-approved profile. Left false, an approved profile returns 409 instead of being silently unapproved.

CompanyUpdateRequest.title: CompanyUpdateRequest
CompanyUpdateRequest.description: Request body for updating a company. All fields optional (partial update).

CompanyWorkflowType.title: CompanyWorkflowType
CompanyWorkflowType.description: Types of workflows that can be run on a company

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the organization holds this certification.

report_doc_id.title: Report Doc Id
report_doc_id.description: Library document id for the uploaded report or certificate.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: Certification id -> status. Unknown ids are ignored by the server.

ComplianceSettingsUpdateRequest.title: ComplianceSettingsUpdateRequest
ComplianceSettingsUpdateRequest.description:
Mirrors `UpdateComplianceSettingsRequest`.

A PARTIAL patch keyed by certification id: only the ids you send are
touched, and an id the product does not support is ignored rather than
rejected - which is the app's behaviour, not a choice made here. Read
`GET /org/settings/compliance` for the supported ids.

ConceptsRequest.title: ConceptsRequest
ConceptsRequest.description:
Cheap creative directions to react to BEFORE generating. SPENDS CREDIT.

One LLM call for 3-6 directions, which is the point: it is far cheaper
than generating that many creatives and throwing five away.

list_id.title: List Id
list_id.description: Source COMPANY list.

auto_import.title: Auto Import
auto_import.description: Import results as soon as they are found, with no review step. This is what turns a saved configuration into an immediate run.

ConfigureFindPeopleRequest.title: ConfigureFindPeopleRequest
ConfigureFindPeopleRequest.description: Set up a people search across a company list.

source_type.title: Source Type
source_type.description: Which kind of source feeds this column.

rotate_existing.title: Rotate Existing
rotate_existing.description: Explicitly acknowledge that an existing credential is invalidated IMMEDIATELY. Anything already posting with the old key stops.

expires_in_days.title: Expires In Days
expires_in_days.description: Credential lifetime, applied when one is first generated.

ConfigureRawSourceRequest.title: ConfigureRawSourceRequest
ConfigureRawSourceRequest.description: Bind an ingest source to a column.

domain_column.title: Domain Column
domain_column.description: Column holding company domains or LinkedIn URLs.

broad_search_acknowledged.title: Broad Search Acknowledged
broad_search_acknowledged.description: Confirm an EMPTY filter set is intentional. An unfiltered search returns the widest - and most expensive - possible result.

max_total_people.title: Max Total People
max_total_people.description: Hard ceiling across every company row.

ConfigureStagingFindPeopleRequest.title: ConfigureStagingFindPeopleRequest
ConfigureStagingFindPeopleRequest.description: Search for contacts at each company row in a workbench table.

field_mappings_override.title: Field Mappings Override
field_mappings_override.description: Per entity type, the mappings to use instead of the discovered ones. Omit to accept what discovery proposed.

selected_list_ids.title: Selected List Ids
selected_list_ids.description: Import only these CRM lists. Omit to take every discovered list.

ConfirmMigrationRequest.title: ConfirmMigrationRequest
ConfirmMigrationRequest.description:
Accept a discovery and START IMPORTING.

This is the irreversible half: records begin landing in graph8 and a
migration cannot be un-run, only cancelled part-way.

Both fields are OPTIONAL and omitting them accepts the discovery as
proposed - which is the point of previewing it first. Send
`field_mappings_override` to change where a CRM field lands, or
`selected_list_ids` to import only some lists.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Repository provider: github, gitlab, local

ConnectionListPayload.title: ConnectionListPayload
ConnectionListPayload.description: An open envelope for a LIST result, so a bare list keeps its shape.

ConnectionPayload.title: ConnectionPayload
ConnectionPayload.description:
An open envelope for a connection, a token or a migration report.

Open because the migration STATUS payload carries a per-entity progress
map, a discovered-field map and a pipeline list that all grow with the
providers - and because a dropped warning on a migration report reads as
"nothing went wrong".

list_id.title: List Id
list_id.description: Target list ID

custom_fields.title: Custom Fields
custom_fields.description: Custom column values to write on this record, keyed by the column's display title (e.g. 'Followup 1'), its slug (e.g. 'udo_followup_1_ab12cd34'), or a case/space variant of the title. Keys that match no existing column are reported back in `ignored_fields` unless `create_missing_fields` is true.

create_missing_fields.title: Create Missing Fields
create_missing_fields.description: When true, any key in `custom_fields` that matches no existing column is created as a NEW list-scoped custom column (max 100 per request) and then written. Default false preserves the previous behaviour of not creating columns implicitly.

ContactBrief.title: ContactBrief
ContactBrief.description:
Lightweight contact summary embedded in deal responses.

`id` is the canonical `mashup_contact_id` (BigInt), matching how contacts
are addressed everywhere else in the public API (g8_search_contacts,
g8_lookup_person, etc.). `role` is the contact's role within THIS deal
(champion / decision_maker / influencer / blocker / coach / end_user) and
is null when no role was set.

ContactCaptureRule.title: ContactCaptureRule
ContactCaptureRule.description: When a matched post's author becomes a graph8 contact.

list_id.title: List Id
list_id.description: Optional target list ID. When provided, the contact is added to this list after it is created; omit to create the contact without a list.

custom_fields.title: Custom Fields
custom_fields.description: Custom column values keyed by the column's display title (e.g. 'Followup 1'), its slug (e.g. 'udo_followup_1_ab12cd34'), or a case/space variant of the title. Keys matching no existing column are reported in the response's `custom_fields.ignored` unless `create_missing_fields` is true.

create_missing_fields.title: Create Missing Fields
create_missing_fields.description: When true, custom_fields keys that match no existing column are created as NEW custom columns (list-scoped when list_id is set) and then written.

ContactDealResponse.title: ContactDealResponse
ContactDealResponse.description: Deal response from contact or company deals handler (dict-based).

ContactListItem.title: ContactListItem
ContactListItem.description: Lighter contact representation for list endpoints.

message.title: Message
message.description: What the user needs help with, in their own words.

contact_email.title: Contact Email
contact_email.description: Where graph8 support should reply. Optional for personal API keys (the key's own user email is used); REQUIRED for org-scoped machine keys, which carry no personal email.

ContactSupportRequest.title: ContactSupportRequest
ContactSupportRequest.description:
A support request relayed from an AI client (or direct API caller).

``urgency`` is deliberately a free-form string, not an enum — LLM callers
produce arbitrary phrasing and a 422 on vocabulary would block a user who
is already asking for help. Urgent-flavored values ("high", "urgent",
"critical", "asap") get a visible subject-line prefix; everything else is
passed through as informational text.

notified.title: Notified
notified.description: Support staff notified on this call (0 on cooldown).

reply_email.title: Reply Email
reply_email.description: Address graph8 support will reply to.

note.title: Note
note.description: Human-readable summary for the caller to relay to the user.

ContactSupportResponse.title: ContactSupportResponse
ContactSupportResponse.description:
Acknowledgment for a support request.

``status`` is ``received`` on first delivery and ``already_received`` when
the per-user cooldown swallowed a duplicate (still HTTP 200 — a retryable
error code would make LLM callers loop harder).

source_tag_ids.title: Source Tag Ids
source_tag_ids.description: Tags to fold in. Removed on success.

target_tag_id.title: Target Tag Id
target_tag_id.description: Tag that survives and absorbs the assignments.

ContactTagUpdateRequest.title: ContactTagUpdateRequest
ContactTagUpdateRequest.description: Every field is optional; omit one to leave it untouched.

ContactTagWriteResult.title: ContactTagWriteResult
ContactTagWriteResult.description: Whatever the handler reports about a write - counts, ids, or both.

ContactUpdateRequest.title: ContactUpdateRequest
ContactUpdateRequest.description: Request body for updating a contact. All fields optional (partial update).

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: The tail hit the per-container byte cap. Earlier output exists and was not returned.

ContainerLogResponse.title: ContainerLogResponse
ContainerLogResponse.description:
One container's tail of output.

A build is five steps in one pod (fetch, scan-source, build, scan-image,
push), so a single flat blob would leave a caller unable to say which step
failed. ``kind`` separates the four init steps from the one container, which
is the ordering Kubernetes actually runs them in.

skill_id.title: Skill Id
skill_id.description: The content skill this column runs.

input_mapping.title: Input Mapping
input_mapping.description: Skill input name -> row field it reads, e.g. `{"keyword": "target_keyword"}`.

row_ids.title: Row Ids
row_ids.description: Only these rows. Omit for every row.

ContentGridSkillPayload.title: ContentGridSkillPayload
ContentGridSkillPayload.description: A grid column, a queued run, or a run's result.

type.title: Type
type.description: `website`/`blog`/`docs`/`developers` are properties you OWN; `linkedin`/`reddit`/`twitter` are external channels.

url.title: Url
url.description: Full URL - the site URL for an owned property, the profile URL for an external channel.

primary.title: Primary
primary.description: Owned types only. The single primary website, mirrored to the org's `primary_website_url`. At most one source may set it.

ContentSourceItem.title: ContentSourceItem
ContentSourceItem.description:
Mirrors `campaign_builder.routers.org_settings.ContentSourceItem`.

`extra="forbid"` matches the app: a typo'd key on a content source is a
silently ignored instruction otherwise, and the list is REPLACED wholesale
on every write, so a dropped key is a dropped source.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: The complete set of content sources. Anything omitted is deleted.

ContentSourcesUpdateRequest.title: ContentSourcesUpdateRequest
ContentSourcesUpdateRequest.description:
Mirrors `UpdateContentSourcesRequest`.

REPLACES the whole list. There is no partial update: send every source you
want to keep, or it is removed.

start_url.title: Start Url
start_url.description: Must be on the org's registered website.

max_pages.title: Max Pages
max_pages.description: The ceiling on pages crawled - and on the spend.

ContentWorkspaceCrawlRequest.title: ContentWorkspaceCrawlRequest
ContentWorkspaceCrawlRequest.description: Deep-crawl the org's OWN website. SPENDS PROVIDER CREDIT, per page crawled.

ContentWorkspacePageUpdateRequest.title: ContentWorkspacePageUpdateRequest
ContentWorkspacePageUpdateRequest.description: Partial update of a page's SEO-refresh planning fields.

ContentWorkspaceSitemapImportRequest.title: ContentWorkspaceSitemapImportRequest
ContentWorkspaceSitemapImportRequest.description: Import the pages listed in an XML sitemap.

ContinueVideoClipRequest.title: ContinueVideoClipRequest
ContinueVideoClipRequest.description: Generate the NEXT shot, starting from this clip's last frame. SPENDS CREDIT.

ConversationStateRequest.title: ConversationStateRequest
ConversationStateRequest.description:
Star / archive / spam, from the CALLER's side of the thread only.

Each flag is explicit rather than a toggle, so a retried request is
idempotent instead of flipping the state back. Omitted flags are untouched.

CopilotCanvasContext.title: CopilotCanvasContext
CopilotCanvasContext.description: What the copilot is looking at: a document, a selection, a campaign or account.

CopilotChatMessage.title: CopilotChatMessage
CopilotChatMessage.description: One earlier turn of the conversation.

research.title: Research
research.description: Multi-step deep research. The most expensive option.

CopilotChatRequest.title: CopilotChatRequest
CopilotChatRequest.description: One message to the Studio copilot. SPENDS CREDIT. The answer is returned whole.

keyword_id.title: Keyword Id
keyword_id.description: The buyer-intent keyword to open a conversation about.

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Narrow the context to one company.

contact_id.title: Contact Id
contact_id.description: Narrow the context to one contact.

new_order.title: New Order
new_order.description: For reorder_sections: the new index order.

CopilotLandingPageActionRequest.title: CopilotLandingPageActionRequest
CopilotLandingPageActionRequest.description: A section-level change to a landing page. `edit_section` SPENDS CREDIT.

CopilotMemoryListPayload.title: CopilotMemoryListPayload
CopilotMemoryListPayload.description: An open envelope for a LIST answer, so a bare list keeps its shape.

CopilotMemoryPayload.title: CopilotMemoryPayload
CopilotMemoryPayload.description:
An open envelope for one memory, wiki or sharing answer.

Open because the personal wiki is a DOCUMENT whose sections follow what has
been learned about a person, and because each fact carries provenance -
which mailbox or meeting it came from - that grows as new sources are
connected. Pinning the shape would silently drop the provenance on the
newest source, and on a "what do you know about me" surface a fact with no
visible origin is worse than no fact.

CopilotMentionSearchRequest.title: CopilotMentionSearchRequest
CopilotMentionSearchRequest.description: Find documents, personas, ICPs, campaigns and teammates to @mention.

correspondence_date.title: Correspondence Date
correspondence_date.description: When it happened - NOT when it was recorded. Required.

stakeholder_id.title: Stakeholder Id
stakeholder_id.description: The person at the account, when known.

external_id.title: External Id
external_id.description: Your id for this message. The app uses it to skip duplicates on `/correspondence/import`, so send it to make an import re-runnable.

CorrespondenceCreateRequest.title: CorrespondenceCreateRequest
CorrespondenceCreateRequest.description:
One piece of correspondence with an account.

Mirrors `campaign_builder.routers.correspondence.CorrespondenceCreate`.

`channel` and `direction` are NOT closed here, because the app does not
close them either: it stores whatever it is given. The values it reads
elsewhere are `email` / `linkedin` / `call_notes` and `inbound` /
`outbound`, and a value outside those is accepted and simply never matched
by a filter.

items.title: Items
items.description: The records. Bounded at 500 by this contract - the app has no ceiling, and an unbounded body on a synchronous per-row insert is a request that times out halfway through having written some rows.

CorrespondenceImportRequest.title: CorrespondenceImportRequest
CorrespondenceImportRequest.description:
Bulk import. Mirrors `correspondence.ImportCorrespondenceRequest`.

Partial success is the normal outcome: the response reports `imported`,
`skipped` and `errors` and the HTTP status stays 200, so read the body
rather than the status.

CreateAdCreativeRequest.title: CreateAdCreativeRequest
CreateAdCreativeRequest.description:
Generate an ad creative. SPENDS CREDIT - copy and, by default, imagery.

`image_source` 'ai' generates the image; 'library' takes
`library_image_id` from the image library instead and is the cheaper of
the two.

formats.title: Formats
formats.description: Platform -> ad_format override. Omit for each platform's default.

CreateAdCreativeSetRequest.title: CreateAdCreativeSetRequest
CreateAdCreativeSetRequest.description:
Generate a persona x platform (x variant) matrix of creatives. SPENDS CREDIT.

One full creative per cell: `len(personas) * len(platforms) *
variants_per_cell`, capped at 24 per batch (a larger matrix is a 422).
AI imagery only - `image_source` is fixed to `ai`.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: Which agent drives the loop: 'onboarding', 'dialer_setup', 'sequencer_setup', 'campaign_run', 'voice_setup', 'marketplace', 'dev_setup', or a free-form value for an ad-hoc session.

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: Free text the planner works from.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: 'private' (default) keeps the run yours. 'shared' lets the organization see it, though only you can cancel it.

subject_account_id.title: Subject Account Id
subject_account_id.description: Bind the run to a company.

subject_campaign_id.title: Subject Campaign Id
subject_campaign_id.description: Bind the run to a campaign.

seed_message.title: Seed Message

CreateDefaultWaterfallConfigRequest.title: CreateDefaultWaterfallConfigRequest
CreateDefaultWaterfallConfigRequest.description:
Create (or reuse) a waterfall pipeline for a list.

Three call-styles, in increasing order of control:

1. **Bare** — pass only `list_id`. Server builds a single-step graph8
   lookup pipeline that fills name/email/company for 0 credits.
   Backward-compatible with the pre-2026-06 contract.
2. **By providers** — pass `providers=["hunter","prospeo"]`. Server maps
   each provider to its default email-finder action (see provider matrix
   in `docs/developer-api-reference.md`) and ordered steps. Use this when
   you want a 1-line "try these providers, in this order" pipeline.
3. **By steps** — pass `steps=[...]` with full step shapes. Server
   persists them verbatim. Use this when you need provider-specific
   config (e.g. apollo `reveal_phone_numbers=true`).

`providers[]` and `steps[]` are mutually exclusive — pass one or
neither, not both. `email_verification` may be combined with any
call-style; when set it runs after the main waterfall and follows the
same credit + valid-status rules the UI uses.

`list_id` is required; everything else has a sensible default so callers
pass the minimum. `skip_existing_values` defaults True so we never
overwrite populated fields. Idempotent by `(list_id, name)`.
